annotation.authors_or_issuer: The White House (President Joseph R. Biden Jr.)
annotation.summary_en: US Executive Order 14110 (Oct 30, 2023) setting eight principles and directing agencies to establish AI safety testing, reporting for dual-use foundation models, critical infrastructure risk management, synthetic content labelling, civil rights, workforce and innovation measures. Embodied AI appears only marginally (transportation/autonomous mobility, medical devices). Archived White House page.
key_provisions_or_claims: Companies developing dual-use foundation models must report training activities, model weights security and red-team results to the federal government (Defense Production Act).
NIST to develop AI safety, red-teaming and evaluation guidelines and companion to the AI RMF.
Agencies assess AI risks in critical infrastructure; AI Safety and Security Board created.
DOT to assess AI in transportation including autonomous mobility; HHS AI task force and safety program for AI-enabled health tech.
Creates White House AI Council; directs guidance on synthetic content labelling, civil rights, workers, and IP.
